notes.title: Cannon Update (Large)
notes.content:
- Cannon System Added
- New High Score system for leaderboard 
- More Bugs than there ever should've been, I apologize 
- Saving should be solved, thank you for your patience 
- The pacing of the game is now completely different, my goal is to never leave the player with nothing to do, if you have any ideas please let me know, thank you!

notes.content: - Added safety reset, if all else fails with the old save system hold both "Q" and "P" together for 15 seconds to reset save.
